evidence.title: Fira confirms Nebius Pajarila first-phase construction
evidence.excerpt: Fira reports it has begun construction of the Nebius campus in Pajarila, south of Highway 6. Main works began during July after spring earthworks, with the first building expected in the first half of 2027.
